opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Establish a standard economic lead while teching towards cybernetics core for early upgrades or tech options.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high support of 4968 games and a winrate of 56.2%.
The medoid key sequence is 'Prod_Gateway > Gas > Base > Tech_CyberneticsCore > Gas2', indicating a gateway before expansion and early gas.
The distinctive flag 'has_cyber' is present in 98.2% of games, compared to a 74.6% baseline, showing a strong association with cybernetics core.
The profile shows high investment in technology (0.782) and economy (0.593), with low investment in defense (0.0003), suggesting a focus on tech and economy over early aggression.
